name: bridge-mind
description: Cognitive-support skills for an ESTP thinker with ADHD: rapid-prototype validation, a risk/rollback checklist for irreversible or trading decisions, a system-design devil's-advocate pass, an outward-facing tone check, plus executive-function support — interrupted-work reconstruction, task activation, time-blindness guards, distraction capture, and an unfinished-work audit.

interface.shortDescription: Decision support and ADHD executive function
interface.longDescription: Ten auto-triggering skills split across two layers. Decision support tuned to the ESTP Se-Ti-Fe-Ni function stack: validate cheap-to-reverse choices by running the smallest experiment, brake before irreversible or trading actions with a rollback-first checklist backed by a decision journal, stress-test expensive-to-reverse designs from six months out, and check outward-facing text before it lands harsher than intended. Executive-function support for ADHD: reconstruct what you were doing from git state rather than memory, break task paralysis down to one physical action under two minutes, replace absent time sense with a measured personal estimate multiplier, park distractions in a reviewed inbox instead of chasing them, and audit abandoned work into ship/kill/park decisions. Triggers on English and Traditional Chinese phrasing. Ships two non-blocking hooks: an irreversible-command guard and a session focus timer.
